fact_rule: One fact states one independently operative legal effect. Conditions, exceptions, thresholds and timing are roles or linked facts.

materiality_rules: Every independently operative termination right is material.
Every trigger, condition, exception, cure or notice period, outside-date extension and bar on exercise is material.
families.summary_grammar: [Party] may terminate if [trigger], subject to [conditions and exceptions], by [notice/action], at [time].
compact_omissions: defined-term text when a linked definition is visible
families.absence_semantics: Publish absence only after all termination grants and cross-references are reviewed.

materiality_rules: Every fee amount, payer, payee and payment trigger is material.
Every tail condition, reimbursement obligation, payment deadline and late-interest rule is material. No minimum monetary threshold applies.

role_rules.reverse_fee: Use the same fee fact types. Set payer capacity to BUYER and payee capacity to SELLER.

families.summary_grammar: [Payer] must pay [payee] [amount] when [trigger], within [timing], subject to [conditions and exceptions].
compact_omissions: calculation detail only when the exact fixed amount is also shown and the detail does not change payment scope
families.absence_semantics: Do not infer that a fee, tail or remedy limit is absent from a missing extraction.

materiality_rules: Every prohibited action and permitted-action prerequisite is material.
Every notice, initial-match and subsequent-match period is material.
Every condition or consequence of a recommendation change is material.
families.summary_grammar: [Obligor] must not [action]. [Actor] may [exception action] only if [prerequisites]. Notice and match periods are separate facts.
compact_omissions: repeated defined-term text when the linked definition is visible
families.absence_semantics: Never state that an action or exception is absent unless the full no-shop source closure was lawyer reviewed.

materiality_rules: Every independently operative employee matters provision is material.
Every condition, exception, threshold, timing rule and cross-family dependency that changes its legal effect is material.
families.summary_grammar: [Actor or subject] [legal operation] [operative object], when [trigger or timing], subject to [qualifications and exceptions].
compact_omissions: Repeated defined-term text only when the linked definition remains visible.
families.absence_semantics: Publish absence only after every substantive section routed to EMPLOYEE_MATTERS and each required fact type is lawyer reviewed.
